revenue.label: Total Revenue (GMV)
revenue.description: Total gross merchandise volume including product price and freight charges.
revenue.sql_formula: SELECT SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) FROM olist_order_items oi

revenue_delivered.label: Delivered Revenue
revenue_delivered.description: Total revenue from orders with delivered status.
revenue_delivered.sql_formula: SELECT SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) FROM olist_order_items oi JOIN olist_orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'

total_orders.label: Total Orders
total_orders.description: Count of all orders in the system.

delivered_orders.label: Delivered Orders
delivered_orders.description: Count of orders with delivered status.
delivered_orders.sql_formula: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM olist_orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered'

pending_orders.label: Pending Orders
pending_orders.description: Orders still being processed (invoiced, processing, shipped).
pending_orders.sql_formula: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM olist_orders WHERE order_status IN ('invoiced', 'processing', 'shipped', 'approved')

canceled_orders.label: Canceled Orders
canceled_orders.sql_formula: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM olist_orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled'

aov.label: Average Order Value
aov.description: The average amount spent per order.
aov.sql_formula: SELECT SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) FROM olist_order_items oi

aov_delivered.label: Avg Order Value (Delivered)
aov_delivered.description: Average order value for delivered orders only.
aov_delivered.sql_formula: SELECT SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) FROM olist_order_items oi JOIN olist_orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'

on_time_delivery_rate.label: On-Time Delivery Rate
on_time_delivery_rate.description: Percentage of orders delivered before or on the estimated delivery date.
on_time_delivery_rate.sql_formula: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date <= o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100 FROM olist_orders o WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

avg_review_score.label: Average Review Score
avg_review_score.description: The mean rating given by customers in their reviews (1 to 5).

cancellation_rate.label: Order Cancellation Rate
cancellation_rate.description: Percentage of total orders that were canceled.
cancellation_rate.sql_formula: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN order_status = 'canceled' THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100 FROM olist_orders

freight_ratio.label: Freight-to-Price Ratio
freight_ratio.description: The proportion of total cost attributed to shipping charges.
freight_ratio.sql_formula: SELECT SUM(oi.freight_value) / SUM(oi.price) * 100 FROM olist_order_items oi

avg_payment_installments.label: Average Payment Installments
avg_payment_installments.description: The average number of installments chosen by customers.

total_customers.label: Total Customers
total_customers.description: Count of unique customers in the system.

total_products.label: Total Products
total_products.description: Count of unique products in the system.

total_sellers.label: Total Sellers
total_sellers.description: Count of unique sellers in the system.

total_revenue_retail.label: Total Revenue (Online Retail)
total_revenue_retail.description: Total revenue from Online Retail dataset.
total_revenue_retail.sql_formula: SELECT SUM(rii.totalprice) FROM retail_invoice_items rii JOIN retail_invoices ri ON rii.invoiceno = ri.invoiceno WHERE ri.is_cancellation = FALSE

retail_orders.label: Total Retail Invoices
retail_orders.sql_formula: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retail_invoices WHERE is_cancellation = FALSE

top_categories_by_revenue.label: Top Product Categories by Revenue
top_categories_by_revenue.description: Ranking of product categories based on total generated revenue.
top_categories_by_revenue.sql_formula: SELECT ct.category_name_en AS category, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS revenue FROM olist_order_items oi JOIN olist_orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN olist_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN olist_product_category_translation ct ON p.category_name_pt = ct.category_name_pt WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

customer_geographic_concentration.label: Revenue by State
customer_geographic_concentration.sql_formula: SELECT c.state, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS revenue FROM olist_order_items oi JOIN olist_orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN olist_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

top_selling_products.label: Top Selling Products
top_selling_products.sql_formula: SELECT p.category_name_pt AS product, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS total, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM olist_order_items oi JOIN olist_orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN olist_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

payment_type_distribution.label: Payment Type Distribution
payment_type_distribution.description: Breakdown of orders by payment method.
payment_type_distribution.sql_formula: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(payment_value) AS total_value FROM olist_order_payments GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

monthly_revenue_trend.label: Monthly Revenue Trend
monthly_revenue_trend.sql_formula: SELECT TO_CHAR(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders FROM olist_order_items oi JOIN olist_orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

review_score_distribution.label: Review Score Distribution
review_score_distribution.sql_formula: SELECT review_score AS score, COUNT(*) AS count FROM olist_order_reviews WHERE review_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

order_status_breakdown.label: Order Status Breakdown
order_status_breakdown.sql_formula: SELECT order_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM olist_orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
